title: Vashishthya Master Client Desk
description: Canonical Notion Master Database Schema with 7 Core Services, 4 Financial Properties, 5-Step Sub-Task Checklists, and Dynamic Progress Formulas

Scholar Name.description: Full name of the student or scholar

Contact / WhatsApp Number.description: Primary mobile number for scholar communications

Email Address.description: Scholar email address for formal document delivery

options.name: 5. Academic Reports & Removal (Turnitin ₹100 / Drillbit ₹200 / Plagiarism Removal)
7. Academic Certificates & Awards (Reviewer / Board / Proposals: AICTE/UGC/DST/DRDO/ISRO)

Agreed Total Fee (INR).description: Total agreed price for the services

Advance Received (INR).description: Upfront deposit or advance payment received

Target Deadline.description: Target completion date agreed with scholar

Progress Bar.expression: let(completed, (if(prop("Step 1: Scope & Topic Confirmation"), 1, 0) + if(prop("Step 2: Outline & Literature Gathering"), 1, 0) + if(prop("Step 3: Draft Writing & Data Analysis"), 1, 0) + if(prop("Step 4: Plagiarism (<10%) & Format Check"), 1, 0) + if(prop("Step 5: Final Delivery & Archive"), 1, 0)) * 20, completed / 100)
Progress Bar.description: Dynamic 0% to 100% progress bar monitoring the 5 steps

1-Click WhatsApp Link.expression: "https://wa.me/91" + replaceAll(prop("Contact / WhatsApp Number"), "[^0-9]", "") + "?text=Hello%20" + encodeURIComponent(prop("Scholar Name")) + "%2C%20your%20order%20status%20is%20" + encodeURIComponent(prop("Status")) + "%20with%20Balance%20Due%3A%20INR%20" + style(prop("Balance Due (INR)"), "bold")
